{{Quote|We got demolition charges in last week's raid, but we've had no way to set all of them off at once in a controlled explosion, from afar.|[[Haydel Goravvus]] during a Resistance briefing|<ref name="KOTOR23" />}}
In [[3963 BBY]], members of the [[Taris Resistance]] undertook a '''raid''' on the [[Jedi Tower]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] as part of the [[Taris Siege|battle]] against the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] invaders. The Resistance planted demolition charges in the foundations of the Mandalorian&ndash;occupied [[Jedi academy]] but were unable to detonate them at the [[Time/Legends|time]] due to their inability to detonate all of the charges in a controlled explosion from a safe distance.<ref name="KOTOR23" /> The charges eventually were set off by the Resistance<ref name="KOTOR24" /> a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] later<ref name="KOTOR23" /> in a [[Mission to the Jedi Tower|second mission]] in their attempts to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the leader of the Mandalorian forces, [[Cassus Fett]].<ref name="KOTOR24" />

==Behind the scenes==
The raid was mentioned in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 23|twenty-third issue]] of the [[Marvel Comics|Marvel]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'']], written by [[John Jackson Miller]]<ref name="KOTOR24" /> and published on [[November 28]], [[2007]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54342/star_wars_knights_of_the_old_republic_2006_23|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (2006) #23}}</ref>
